name: 新线路自动命名 | Auto Line Names
summary: 新客货线路自动命名，保留手动名称。Auto-name new passenger/freight lines; preserve custom names.
description:
中文说明

自动为启用后新建的客运和货运线路命名。

命名格式：
• [客运] 地点A-地点B
• [货运] 物品-地点A-地点B

功能：
• 地点优先使用首末站所属城镇；同城线路或没有城镇归属的站点使用站名。
• 物品根据线路装载配置识别；已派车时按车辆有效容量筛选，多种货物以顿号连接。货物未确定时显示“待定”。
• 追加站点、调整装载配置后自动更新。环线跳过末尾重复的首站。
• 保留首次启用时已有线路的名称。
• 手动改名后停止自动覆盖，并在保存后重新加载时保留该选择。
• 仅修改名称；停用后已有名称保留。无需其他 Mod。

语言说明：线路前缀“客运”“货运”和提示“待定”“未知物品”固定中文；货物名称跟随游戏语言，地点沿用存档中的名称。中英文发布介绍不代表线路前缀会自动切换语言。

使用方法：启用 Mod，进入地图后新建线路，添加至少两个不同停靠站，等待游戏脚本更新。建议等自动名称出现后再手动改名。

版本依据：TF3 Steam Build 25533170。28 项自动化模拟测试通过；游戏日志已确认脚本加载与初始化，所有游戏内场景尚未完整验收。封面为 AI 生成示意图。

English Description

Automatically names passenger and freight lines created after enabling the mod.

Naming formats (Chinese prefixes):
• [客运] Place A-Place B
• [货运] Item-Place A-Place B

Features:
• Uses the towns of the first and last stops. Local services and stops without a town assignment use station names.
• Detects items from line loading settings and filters them by assigned vehicles' effective capacities. Multiple items are joined with “、”. Undetermined freight is labelled “待定”.
• Updates names when stops or loading settings change. A repeated first stop at the end of a loop is skipped.
• Preserves lines already present when the mod is first enabled.
• Stops overwriting a line after you rename it manually, and remembers this across saves.
• Changes names only. Existing names remain after disabling the mod. No dependencies.

Language: the passenger/freight prefixes and pending/unknown-item labels remain in Chinese. Item names follow the game language; place names come from the save. This bilingual listing does not imply English line prefixes.

Usage: enable the mod, enter the map, create a new line with at least two different stops, and allow the game scripts to update. Wait for the automatic name before applying a custom name.

Built against TF3 Steam Build 25533170. All 28 automated simulation checks passed; game logs confirm loading and initialization, but full in-game scenario testing is still pending. The cover is an AI-generated illustration.
